Application Data.NAME: Smith Building Supplies, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Building Supplies, LLC specializes in the retail sale of building materials and supplies, including lumber, drywall, insulation, and associated hardware. We cater primarily to local contractors and DIY homeowners, ensuring that all materials are sourced from approved domestic manufacturers. Our operations focus on maintaining a secure inventory with indoor storage and regular inventory audits, supported by a comprehensive safety program that includes fire prevention measures and surveillance systems to mitigate theft risks.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/10/2023, a fire in the storage facility caused damage to inventory amounting to $5,000. The affected items included several pallets of lumber and drywall. The fire was attributed to an electrical issue, and immediate corrective measures were implemented. The claim was reported to the insurance company, and the status is currently under review for reimbursement.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1 Safe - UL Listed for Fire and Theft Protection, Model SB-2500
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing around the inventory area, monitored surveillance cameras with motion detection, and on-site security personnel during non-business hours.
